description:
Alarm, clock, timer and stopwatch with advanced alarm tools AlarmClock Deluxe (Wecker, Uhr, Timer, Stoppuhr) (de.huttersoft.mightyalarmclock) is a fork of BlackyHawky's Clock, itself based on AOSP, released under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0). Does not use the internet permission, and thus is 100% offline. The location permission is used only to read the SSID of the connected Wi-Fi network for optional per-alarm Wi-Fi rules. No location data is collected or sent; the app cannot access the internet. On top of everything the original Clock app offers, AlarmClock Deluxe adds:
  • A fire queue so multiple alarms firing close together are presented one after another instead of being marked missed;
  • Progressive snooze (each snooze can automatically get longer) plus a manual snooze duration picker;
  • Global mute: silence or vibrate-only every alarm until a chosen time;
  • Naming a new alarm right when it's created;
  • Searching, filtering and extra sorting options for the alarm list;
  • Tags with their own ringtone, automatically used by alarms that don't set one explicitly;
  • Device-wide alarm statistics with a shareable event log;
  • Wi-Fi based rules to automatically enable/disable alarms depending on the connected network;
  • Plain JSON backups (no ZIP) to a folder of your choice, with optional scheduled backups;
  • An experimental "exchange" mechanism to move or share alarms between devices via a shared folder;
  • Multiple named stopwatches that can run in parallel, with runs recorded in the event log;
  • A small rotatable timezone globe on the clock screen showing your selected world cities;
...and the full original Clock feature set:
  • Set the alarms to a specific date;
  • Flip and shake action to dismiss/postpone alarm;
  • Turn off/postpone the alarm with the power button or volume buttons;
  • Swipe to delete an alarm;
  • Duplicate alarms;
  • Customizable alarm title and ringtone;
  • Light, dark or system theme, with AMOLED mode;
  • Customizable interface;
  • Digital or analog clock style;
  • Display home time when traveling, and the time in many cities around the world;
  • Timer and stopwatch included;
  • Customizable screensaver;
  • Modern, customizable widgets;
  • Support for tiles in quick settings (for Android 7+);
  • Backup and restore application data;
  • Material design with dynamic colors for Android 12+;
